nodes.description: The truncating variants all lie in the 5' part of TRA2B, upstream of an alternative translation start site. In patient-derived cells they lower the canonical full-length Tra2-beta-1 isoform and raise the noncanonical Tra2-beta-3 isoform, which starts downstream and lacks the N-terminal RS1 domain. Tra2-beta is a sequence-specific splicing regulator that binds GAA-rich motifs in pre-mRNA; the bound molecular function is marked dysregulated because the binding-and-activating canonical protein is replaced by a shorter repressive form. RNA binding by Tra2-beta-3 was not measured.
